name: Scale AI

source.quote: Scale AI, co-founded by CEO Alexandr Wang in 2016, reported $870m in revenue last year and anticipates sales to exceed $2bn in 2025.
KUALA LUMPUR: Meta Platforms has finalised an investment in Scale AI that values the startup at over US$29 billion, Scale AI said on Thursday.

description: Provides labeled training data and AI evaluation services to AI labs, companies and governments.
explain: Scale AI supplies the human-labeled data that labs use to train models; Meta owns 49% of it after a $14.3 billion investment in 2025.
